profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Deloitte | Developing reusable microservices, front-end features
profile.summary:
As a Software Engineer at Deloitte, I specialize in developing scalable, reusable microservices that streamline team workflows and drive operational efficiency for Deloitte’s Government & Public Services (GPS) clients.

My expertise spans back-end development using Python, FastAPI, and Django Rest Framework, as well as front-end technologies such as React and TypeScript. My technical toolkit also includes extensive experience with cloud services, generative AI, and CI/CD pipelines, enabling rapid, secure, and reliable software delivery.

I thrive in environments where continuous improvement, cross-functional teamwork, and client-centric problem solving are valued. Motivated by opportunities to collaborate and innovate, I am committed to delivering impactful solutions that align with team and organizational goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developing reusable microservices to accelerate team development processes.
• Implementing front-end features using React and TypeScript for enhanced user experience.
• Building API endpoints with Python and Django Rest Framework to efficiently serve complex client data.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Enhanced core client side application by building main product features using JavaScript and Java backend service
• Implemented unit and e2e testing with Jest, Karma, and Playwright to ensure code quality
• Shared knowledge with teammates through stand ups, project work, slack channels, and code reviews

positions.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed full-stack internal tools using React JS and FastApi Python to enhance team efficiency
• Collaborated with technical account managers to assess complex implementation requests
• Monitored alert channels and provided timely fixes to ensure smooth operations
positions.insights: Technical Solution Design, React and +1 skill

positions.title: Implementation Engineer
positions.description:
• Led end-to-end coding and configuration of complex ad service implementations for top tier clients.
• Utilized Chrome Dev tools, client emulation tools, and deep product knowledge for in-depth troubleshooting.
• Achieved successful implementation of ad services resulting in increased client satisfaction and revenue growth.
positions.insights: Integration Engineering, Vanilla JavaScript and +1 skill

positions.title: Technical Integration Specialist
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained Riskified’s public facing SDKs using PHP, Java, and .NET to align with API updates from the Software Engineering team
• Collaborated remotely with dev teams in other offices to integrate top online shops by creating Ruby and Python scripts for data normalization
• Built internal tools to streamline integration processes and ensure data integrity
